title: Batched analytics intake
description: POST /v1/event. No PII and no message content, ever (FR-034). This intake is also why disputed-conversation capture is deferred (FR-041): it forbids message content and MUST continue to.

name.description: Closed set. An unknown name is a 400, not a silent insert — an open name field is how message content ends up in an analytics table. Every learner-facing affordance the service exposes must appear here: an affordance nobody can query is one nobody can judge against the D7 rule.

additionalProperties.description: Scalars only. No nesting. 64 chars max — long enough for an id or an enum, far too short for a conversation turn.
